skill_card.name: Reverse Engineering Skill
skill_card.description: An offline, deterministic architecture recovery skill that scans polyglot codebases to extract module boundaries, dependency graphs, API catalogs, data schemas, security perimeters, and generate interactive architecture dashboards.

tasks.name: Index repository and extract symbols
tasks.description: Parses multi-language source trees to extract classes, functions, imports, endpoints, database models, and service interfaces.
tasks.output_schema: Structured AST symbol table and component catalog.

tasks.name: Construct system architecture models
tasks.description: Builds component interaction graphs, module hierarchies, and data-flow models with zero external network dependencies.
tasks.output_schema: Directed architecture graph and dependency adjacency matrices.

tasks.name: Generate architecture reports and interactive dashboard
tasks.description: Produces comprehensive system overview markdown, Mermaid diagrams, and an offline interactive HTML visual dashboard.
tasks.output_schema: Architecture specification markdown and standalone HTML dashboard.

documentation.changelog: Initial verified release based on the published marketplace skill documentation.
